entities.name: Thran Civil War
entities.description: Power struggle between elite imperialists and republican commoners.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: Thran artificer exiled and recalled, who cured Glacian's disease, seized power and took the Thran into Phyrexia.

entities.name: Glacian
entities.description: A Thran stabbed by Gix with a powerstone and afflicted with phthisis.

entities.name: Gix
entities.description: Untouchable who stabbed Glacian and led two uprisings; forced into Yawgmoth's service.

entities.name: Rebbec
entities.description: Recalled Yawgmoth from exile and later closed the portal to Phyrexia.

entities.name: Jonas
entities.description: Killed in the first Untouchable uprising.

entities.name: Dyfed
entities.description: Planeswalker who showed Yawgmoth Pyrulea and Phyrexia.

entities.name: Untouchables
entities.description: Caste infected en masse with phthisis, who rose up under Gix.

entities.name: Thran Alliance
entities.description: Alliance of dwarves, elves, minotaurs, viashino, cat people and barbarians that fought Yawgmoth.

entities.name: Elder Council
entities.description: Ruling council of Halcyon, overthrown by Yawgmoth.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: Plane shown to Yawgmoth by Dyfed.

entities.name: Null Sphere
entities.description: Claimed by Yawgmoth in the Battle of the Null Sphere.

entities.name: Null Moon
entities.description: Brought into orbit during the Battle of Halcyon.

entities.name: Thran-Phyrexian War
entities.description: War against which the timeline is dated.

events.summary: Halcyon becomes the Thran capital and the Thran Civil War breaks out.
events.quote: The Thran Civil War breaks out - a power struggle between the elite imperialists and republican commoners

events.summary: The Halcyon elite stamps out the last republican resistance, exiling the eugenicists and ending the civil war.
events.quote: All the eugenicists are exiled, and the Thran Civil War officially ends.

events.summary: Gix stabs Glacian with a powerstone during an Untouchable riot, giving him phthisis.
events.quote: Glacian is stabbed by Gix using a powerstone during an Untouchable riot and is afflicted with phthisis .

events.summary: Rebbec recalls Yawgmoth from exile; he finds phthisis is caused by powerstone radiation.
events.quote: Yawgmoth is recalled from exile by Rebbec to cure Glacian.

events.summary: Gix leads the first Untouchable uprising, Jonas dies, and Yawgmoth's serum quells it.
events.quote: Gix leads the first Untouchables' uprising to take vengeance on the people who afflicted them with phthisis.

events.summary: The planeswalker Dyfed shows Yawgmoth the plane of Pyrulea.
events.quote: A planeswalker named Dyfed appears before Yawgmoth and shows him the plane of Pyrulea .

events.summary: Gix leads a second rebellion, letting Yawgmoth claim emergency power and force Gix into his service.
events.quote: this time forcing Gix into his personal service.

events.summary: Yawgmoth overthrows the Elder Council and prepares for war after the Thran Alliance demands his removal.
events.quote: Yawgmoth overthrows the Elder Council and starts to prepare for war.

events.summary: Dyfed takes the imprisoned Elder Council to Mercadia and shows Yawgmoth Phyrexia, opening a stable portal.
events.quote: Yawgmoth is shown Phyrexia by Dyfed, who opens a stable portal between that plane and Dominaria.

events.summary: Yawgmoth claims the Null Sphere at the Battle of the Null Sphere.
events.quote: Yawgmoth claims the Null Sphere , lifting it into the air with a powerstone equator.

events.summary: Yawgmoth defeats the Thran Alliance and wipes out Thran cities, but Rebbec closes the portal trapping him in Phyrexia.
events.quote: but Rebbec closes the portal from Dominaria to Phyrexia with Yawgmoth and his followers are trapped on the other side.

relations.quote: this time forcing Gix into his personal service.
The Alliance tells Halcyon to rid Yawgmoth of his privileges, or they will declare war.
Yawgmoth is recalled from exile by Rebbec to cure Glacian.
